components.name: Chart/Waterfall
components.description: How a starting value becomes an end value through positive and negative contributions (P&L, cash flow, budget bridge). Totals = dataviz/neutral from zero; increases dataviz/positive; decreases dataviz/negative; dashed connectors carry the running level. Signed labels with true minus (−). React: <WaterfallChart start items end />
